@UAECALUMMATHS · MAX
◆ What he did wrong
  1. He didn't have the cash to see it through. Instalments kept coming. He couldn't fund them, so he had to take the offer on the table.
  2. He sold into a soft month. June 2026 - the whole market's seven months into a slide. Forced sellers meet a buyer's market.
  3. He paid the launch premium and then couldn't wait for it to be earned. Off-plan pays at handover. He exited at the bottom of the curve.

@UAECALUMDLD REGISTER
◆ The difference

One bought a villa.
The other bought a payment schedule.

Same developer. Same launch year. Same market. The winner could fund every instalment to handover and chose his exit. The loser's exit was chosen for him.

The developer has since dropped its resale threshold - so fewer buyers get forced into selling below what they paid.
@UAECALUMTHE RULE
◆ Before you buy off-plan
  1. Write down every instalment date to handover. Then add 12 months.
  2. Have the cash for all of it before you sign - not "by then".
  3. Know the resale rule: what % paid before you're allowed out.
  4. Never be the seller who has to. The register is full of them.
Đ2.7M. Twenty-three months. Zero keys.
